raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Provision an AWS Lambda function 'order-processor' triggered by an SQS queue (Python 3.12), with production-ready defaults.

Parameters:
  CodeS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket containing the Lambda deployment package (ZIP).
  CodeS3Key:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 key of the Lambda deployment package (ZIP).
  CodeS3ObjectVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 object version for the Lambda package (optional but recommended for immutability).
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Lambda function timeout in seconds.
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Lambda memory size in MB.
  ReservedConcurrentExecutions:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Reserved concurrency limit for the Lambda function (0 = unreserved).
  BatchSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Maximum number of messages per batch for SQS event source.
  MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 300
    Description: Maximum batching window in seconds for SQS event source.
  MaximumConcurrency:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Maximum concurrency for SQS event source mapping (limits concurrent batches).
  QueueVisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 43200
    Description: SQS queue visibility timeout in seconds (should exceed Lambda timeout).
  SqsMessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: SQS message retention period in seconds.
  RedriveMaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
    Description: Max receives before messages are sent to DLQ.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Log retention in days for the Lambda log group.

Conditions:
  HasCodeS3ObjectVersion: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, ""]]

Resources:
  OrderDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref SqsMessageRetentionPeriod
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: order-processor
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DLQ

  OrderQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref SqsMessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref QueueVisibilityTimeout
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 20
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrderDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: !Ref RedriveMaxReceiveCount
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: order-processor
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: PrimaryQueue

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub order-processor-exec-role-${AWS::StackName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: order-processor-sqs-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SQSPollAndAcknowledge
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: order-processor

  OrderProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/order-processor
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: order-processor

  OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: order-processor
      Description: Processes order events from SQS with robust, secure defaults.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: !Ref ReservedConcurrentExecutions
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          QUEUE_URL: !Ref OrderQueue
          QUEUE_ARN: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref CodeS3Bucket
        S3Key: !Ref CodeS3Key
        S3ObjectVersion: !If [HasCodeS3ObjectVersion, !Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: order-processor
    DependsOn:
      - OrderProcessorLogGroup

  OrderQueueEventSourceMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !Ref OrderProcessorFunction
      Enabled: true
      BatchSize: !Ref BatchSize
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: !Ref MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds
      FunctionResponseTypes:
        - ReportBatchItemFailures
      ScalingConfig:
        MaximumConcurrency: !Ref MaximumConcurrency

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the order-processor Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn
  SqsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the primary SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref OrderQueue
  SqsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the primary SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
  SqsDLQUrl:
    Description: URL of the dead-letter SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref OrderDLQ
